gallery.title: File:Admiralty-yacht-HMS-Iolaire-ship-Amalthaea-1908.jpg
gallery.description: The steam yacht Amalthaea in 1908. In 1915 she became an armed yacht, and in 1918 she was renamed HMY Iolaire. She sank on the morning of 1 January 1919 on the Beasts of Holm, rocks outside Stornoway harbour.
